newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia, IMF to host economic meeting.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, IMF to host economic meeting.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) will host a conference on November 7 and 8 on macro-economic issues affecting Asian countries, banking officials said on Thursday.
A central bank official told Reuters finance ministers and central bank governors from Southeast Asian nations and IMF managing-director Michael Camdessus would attend the meeting.
